honest_c3: C1 — train-mode mac inference epistemic limitation: this audit derives train-time emit magnitude from SOURCE (SOC threshold = 1.5; EMA bounds [0.3, 5.0]). Does NOT execute real forward passes on trained best.pt to harvest empirical c.get_states() distributions. The empirical SS norm at training step 20K is unknown without loading best.pt['federation'/'c_engine'] and inspecting cell norms.

C2 — shape vs magnitude entanglement is not addressed by simple sweep: BG-Q fixture is axis-concentrated (AXIS_SPANS slices 38-39d); training emit is broadband 192d. Magnitude-only calibration cannot fix shape mismatch. F-CAND-D-1 PASS at any mag does NOT imply substrate-realistic injection — only proves cross_attn pathway is content-readable.

C3 — n_cells compression: training uses total_cells=96 (12 atoms x 8 cells, 350m scale); HF inference fixture path expects n_cells=8. ~12x compression silently accepted by BG-Q/BG-W. Either cross_attn handles arbitrary S without quality loss (archaeology §6.1), OR 8-cell fixture is undersampling the training cell trajectory. Empirically untested.

C4 — c_proj projection in training is not reflected in inference fixture: c_proj weights saved in best.pt; HF inference path does NOT load c_proj; BG-Q fixture fed RAW into cross_attn. At-inference fixture distribution must include c_proj transform OR be expressed in c_proj output basis. This audit did NOT extract c_proj weights or dim.

C5 — SOC EMA at convergence empirically unknown: _soc_threshold_ema starts at 1.5 and adapts (1.0 +/- adapt_rate) per step. Over 20K training steps EMA could have drifted to any value in [0.3, 5.0]. Without loading best.pt and inspecting _soc_threshold_ema, the ACTUAL train-time per-cell norm at convergence is unknown within [0.3, 5.0]. The '~1.5' recommendation is DEFAULT, not measured end-state.

C6 — best.pt key inspection not performed: train_avg_harvest_result.json:ckpt_top_keys shows best.pt contains 'c_proj','federation','bridge' but not 'c_engine' directly. The C-module state may live under 'federation' (FederatedConsciousness). Needs verification by running torch.load(best.pt) and inspecting nested keys. This audit did NOT perform that load.

C7 — BG-W trajectory at mag=1.5 is interpolated, not measured: §5 estimate ~2e-4 drift at mag=1.5 is linear interp between BG-W mag=1.0 (2.79e-4) and mag=2.0 (6.48e-4). Actual mag=1.5 datapoint was NOT in BG-W's swept set. A focused subsweep at {1.0, 1.5, 2.0, 3.0} would tighten realistic-magnitude drift estimate.
